- What formats do you support for bulk export (JSONL/Parquet/CSV)? Any column/field mapping docs you can share?
- For EU-resident customers, will the physical export be generated from EU storage only (no cross-region movement)?

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details below and an attachment with a compact export spec (export_spec_v1.pdf).

- Formats: we support newline-delimited JSON (JSONL), Parquet (partitioned by date), and CSV exports. Parquet is preferred for large ranges because it compresses and preserves typed columns.
- EU residency: for tenants configured with EU residency we generate exports from EU-backed object storage only. We do not stream raw logs across regions during generation; any temporary processing happens inside the EU region.
- Retention: hosted-default is 90 days for audit/access logs. We can produce exports covering up to 24 months on request (subject to availability and ops lead time). For Dedicated/Private installs retention windows are configurable per contract.
- Deletion proof: our standard deliverable is a signed manifest that lists exported objects, byte counts, and SHA256 hashes, plus a deletion certificate when we run a deletion job. The deletion certificate includes timestamps for each shard and a KMS-signed envelope (if requested) showing the job id and keys used.
- Lead time: typical turnaround is 3 business days for exports covering <=30 days; 5–7 business days for up to 12 months; 7–14 business days for 1–2 years. Large-volume multi-year extracts may require a temporary dedicated export node; that adds 2–4 days to schedule.

A few clarifying questions to scope exactly:
1) Preferred export format (Parquet/JSONL/CSV)?
2) Exact date range (start/end) and approximate token/ingestion volume if known (helps with sizing).
3) Delivery preference: presigned S3 URLs in your EU bucket vs. secure transfer to a FinVero-managed endpoint?

I'll loop in ops to estimate cost and timing once you confirm. The attached spec shows field names and the manifest example we produce.

Best,
Priyom Das
Product Manager, Security & Compliance

Adding ops/approval context. Two operational notes we should flag to FinVero: 

1) For exports >12 months or where we need to seek cold storage slices, we may need a short SLA exception and a one-time staging cost. We'll propose a temporary dedicated node in the EU to accelerate snapshot creation and avoid cross-region egress.

2) For deletion receipts: we can provide a KMS-signed manifest (sha256 checksums + deletion timestamps). If FinVero requires an HSM/KMS envelope attestation (customer-managed keys), that requires coordination with our security team and typically 3–5 business days.

If they confirm Parquet + presigned S3 delivery and want deletion certificate included, I'll greenlight the expedited job and waive storage staging cost for the audit as a one-time courtesy (subject to Ben's sign-off).
